steps.title: Prepare Primary MasterMix
steps.instruction: Prepare a MasterMix in a sterile Eppendorf tube containing SuperMix, primers, and autoclaved mQ water, calculating for one more well than required.

steps.title: Prepare Secondary MasterMix
steps.instruction: Create a secondary MasterMix for each PCR point to ensure triplicates are under identical conditions.

substeps.instruction: Combine 57 ul of the primary MasterMix with 3 ul of cDNA

steps.title: Load qPCR Plate
steps.instruction: Distribute the secondary MasterMix into the plate wells, ensuring no bubbles are present to avoid interference with fluorescence optical measurement.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 19 ul of the 60 ul secondary MasterMix into each well in triplicate

steps.title: Configure Bio-Rad Software
steps.instruction: Set up the qPCR run parameters in the software.

substeps.instruction: Open the program and select user
Click the 'Protocol' tab and either select an existing protocol or create a new one
Click the 'Plate' tab and either select an existing plate configuration (Plate Setup) or create a new one

steps.title: Initiate qPCR Run
steps.instruction: Start the thermal cycling process after verifying settings.

substeps.instruction: Click 'Run' to open the new screen
Ensure that 'Collect Well Factors ...' is marked
